# DueVinci

DueVinci is a privacy-minded academic planner for organizing classes, lessons,
assignments, study plans, grades, focus sessions, and calendars.

## Public pages

- [DueVinci dashboard](https://duevinci.tech/)
- [Privacy policy](https://duevinci.tech/legal/privacy.html)
- [Terms of use](https://duevinci.tech/legal/terms.html)
- [Calendar and schedule documentation](https://duevinci.tech/wiki/Calendar-%26-Schedule-Sync.html)

The permanent free core includes manual planning, calendar events, `.ics`
import/export, grades, timers, study planning, and data portability. Optional
DueVinci Pro features include connected learning integrations and guided study
support.
